banner: Training rehearsal - synthetic data - not a live Azure result
objective: Choose rollout/probe/surge/grace settings; a PDB is not universal failure protection.
sourceRequiredBehavior: Combine readiness, available surge capacity, suitable rollout availability settings, and graceful termination.
sourceAcceptance: Native pod readiness and grace behavior match the manifest; surge capacity exists; PDBs are not presented as universal protection.
sourceQualification: All pods, nodes, probes, rollout, surge, disruption, grace, drain, requests and state are fixed fictional teaching DATA ONLY. Native source acceptance is not fulfilled by this lesson.
preconditions: Open the complete folder directly in a JavaScript-capable browser.
A fixed workload needs three ready pods; desired replicas are three but never substitute for observed readiness.
Three fictional nodes host three old pods; a fixed optional spare slot permits one candidate pod.
PreStop consumes four seconds of the chosen ten or twenty second grace; old requests need eight and fourteen remaining seconds.
The fictional PDB minimum two applies only to the independent voluntary Eviction API comparison.
actions: Choose bounded rollout, probe, headroom, grace and observation DATA.
Record settings, observe fixed pods/nodes/probes, rehearse one rolling step and drain old work.
Compare one fixed voluntary, node, zone, region or unrecorded disruption DATA case without altering the step result.
Inspect separate positive, negative and unknown transition/drain measurements and retained history.
Use labelled keyboard controls, recover from input/state errors, and reset current controls without erasing earlier results.

syntheticInput.observationPolicy: Fixed fictional teaching DATA ONLY; no actual configuration, fault or request.

expectedAssertions: A surge-first ready compatible step retains ready floor three, peaks at four pods and succeeds for two transitions and two old requests.
A one-pod unavailability allowance permits capacity two and interrupts one transition despite the fictional PDB.
Grace ten leaves six seconds after PreStop and interrupts both old requests.
Failed readiness or absent headroom safely aborts before exposure; unknown readiness/headroom or startup-only evidence stays unverified.
Desired replicas do not certify observed-ready capacity.
Probe HTTP 200 does not conceal two incompatible-state interruptions; missing business trace remains two unknown transitions.
A voluntary eviction may satisfy a PDB while leaving insufficient capacity; two evictions are blocked; arbitrary loss does not consult the budget.
Typed data-only actions, stage guards, immutable private state and bounded histories reject malformed operations without mutation.
Actual browser DOM, keyboard, errors, reset, negative/unknown cases, asset failures and CSP blocks are observed.
Normal verification is read-only; only exact deliberate CAPTURE_BROWSER_EVIDENCE=1 captures browser proof.
limits: No management calls, credentials, packages, frameworks, downloads, scaffold, identity, deployment or spending.
One deterministic rolling step is not complete Deployment convergence, observed native behavior, or universal failure protection.
PDB limits concern voluntary Eviction API disruption, not arbitrary failures or every rollout operation.
History is bounded page-memory only; reset retains it and reload clears it.
B-S127 and D-S127 remain incomplete; native readiness, surge and grace acceptance is unverified.
Node 22 tooling is not production Node 24 validation.
Offline Playwright 1.56.1 / signed installed Edge 156 / published isolated helper only; inactive lifecycle recovery remains unqualified.
